title: GordiumStart (or GordiumCheck) in an empty file starts a new project on the sample: 106 Ithaca Rd's tax-map lot is put on the Site layer and the start box opens prefilled (address, R-1b, one-family, Ithaca Rd)
evidence: gordium_check() on an empty fake document went to gordium_start(), which asked the real checker for sample_site and put one closed lot outline on the Site layer (1 lot candidate). The start box built by gordium_ui.start_box read: title 'New zoning check', address '106 Ithaca Rd, Ithaca, NY', district 'R-1b', street row 'Ithaca Rd', Draw enabled=False before the district is confirmed; Cancel then left 'nothing was started'.
rhino_part: The real command in a real empty Rhino file: the lot curve drawn on the Site layer, the box opening on screen.

title: Ticking 'This is the lot's district' and clicking Draw draws the starting house (3 floors) and checks it: nothing fails, the front yard complies
evidence: Draw saved the facts and the real checker's 'start' drew 3 floor solids (Floor 1, Floor 2, Floor 3, 35.0 tall in all); the check of the exported .3dm says '2 need review · 9 comply · 2 not checked'; nothing does_not_comply (none); Front yard 27'-0 3/4", required 25'-0": complies.
rhino_part: The house drawn in the viewport as one group on Gordium::Massing, the panel showing the result.

title: Moving the house 5 ft toward the street makes the front yard fail (does not comply), with the 'no longer complies' notice
evidence: After a 5 ft move toward the street the Front yard went from 27'-0 3/4" (complies) to 22'-0 7/8": does_not_comply, required 25'-0", delta 'at least 0\'-11" short'; the notice reads 'Front yard no longer complies · 22\'-0 7/8" proposed · 25\'-0" required · at least 0\'-11" short'.
rhino_part: The Move command in Rhino, the live re-check firing on Rhino's idle, the red strip and the notice drawn.

title: Zoning report… writes the report for the model as it is now and it opens on its Check sheet, showing the front yard failing
evidence: open_report() ran a fresh check that wrote demo_smoke_gordium_report.xlsx and asked the OS to open it (['/home/user/wt/coordination/docs/coordination/headless/tmp/demo_smoke_gordium_report.xlsx']); openpyxl reads sheets ['Check', 'Inputs', 'Output', '…'], the active one 'Check', only ['Check'] selected; its title 'GORDIUM | 1 does not comply · 3 need review · 7 comply · 2 not checked'; the Front yard line ['Does not comply', '✕', 'Front yard', '22\'-0 7/8"', '25\'-0"', 'at least 0\'-11" short']; the Output sheet's Front yard row ('Front yard minimum (chart p.3)', '22\'-0 7/8"', 'FAIL'). The open command is open on the Mac and os.startfile on Windows; the panel said ['Report saved to /home/user/wt/coordination/docs/coordination/headless/tmp/demo_smoke_gordium_report.xlsx (opened).'].
rhino_part: Excel or Numbers actually opening the file on Ben's Mac / the cofounders' Windows, on the Check tab.

title: Corner lot: in the start box (Edit site…), Corner lot? Yes, then Change… on the street row, click both street lot lines, Enter: both lines are kept as the street lines, and the check runs on them
evidence: The box (gordium_ui.start_box) answered Yes, Change… returned pick:street; _pick_outcome read 2 clicks then Enter (prompts 'Click each lot line on a street (0 picked); Enter when done' … 'Click each lot line on a street (2 picked); Enter when done'); the facts now hold 2 street lines [[[76.916, 0.2317], [67.113, 0.1516]], [[10.7167, 0.8339], [1.1492, 0.2317]]] (the two clicked, unnamed), corner_lot=True. The check ran: '7 need review · 4 comply · 2 not checked'; front-yard rows {'Front yard': ('needs_review', "the street lot lines given aren't next to each other")} (none complies on a corner lot until the front is settled).

title: The panel's Show neighbourhood tick on the smoke's own file (the sample, 106 Ithaca Rd, not looked up): is there a neighbourhood to hide and show?
evidence: On the sample the neighbourhood frame is None (rhino_logic.context_frame: never around the sample, review round 3), so nothing was drawn at Draw; untick said 'Neighbourhood off (none drawn in this file).', tick said 'No neighbourhood to show: it is drawn around a lot the start box looked up (GordiumStart, type the address, Look up, Draw).'. So the smoke's tick step only means something after Look up.
rhino_part: Ben's run: on the sample the tester must Look up the address (internet, or the recorded fixture) for a neighbourhood to exist; then the real fetch, drawing and tick (claim 6b's logic).

title: With a neighbourhood drawn (a looked-up lot), the tick hides and shows the neighbourhood layers, saved with the file, and the layers stay locked as they should (Parcels, Streets, Notes locked; Gordium::Context and Buildings not)
evidence: show_context off, on, off, on with a drawn neighbourhood (its record in the file; Rhino 8's lock behaviour modelled): visible [[False], [True], [False], [True]]; locks after every tick as wanted; saved in the file as [False, True, False, True]; the panel said 'Neighbourhood hidden.' / 'Neighbourhood shown (drawing only: the check never measures it).'.
rhino_part: Real Rhino 8 layers: the parent-visibility-sets-sublayer-locks behaviour is modelled here as the Rhino job found it (test_context_box.py's _Layer); only Rhino shows the layers really hide and stay locked, and the real fetch and drawing of the neighbourhood.
